title: Make room for a little English every day
description: Build a manageable English learning routine with a few words, a short game, and a little review.

sections.heading: Start with something familiar
paragraphs: Choose a topic you meet in everyday life, such as food or animals. Learn a small set of words and connect each one to something you can picture.

sections.heading: Try remembering before checking
paragraphs: Read the word, think of its meaning, and then choose an answer in the game. If you make a mistake, pause to read the correct meaning before moving on.

sections.heading: Return to the words
paragraphs: Review a few words on another day and try using them in a sentence. Pick a routine that feels manageable rather than rushing through every topic at once.
